item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “These two are so experienced,” Irfan Pathan backs Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma to shine in ODI series
item.description: Veteran India batters Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma will be back in action during the three-match ODI series against New Zealand, starting January 11 in Vadodara. Both of them looked in fine touch in recent assignments against Australia and South Africa. While Rohit clinched the Player-of-the-Series award in Australia, Kohli bagged the honour in the home series against Proteas. item.title: “McCullum took umbrage when I…”: Nasser Hussain reflects on England coach’s response to criticism after Ashes debacle
item.description: Nasser Hussain reflected on Brendon McCullum’s response to criticism following England’s Ashes debacle, after the head coach took offence to remarks made by the former captain. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “Hasn’t won World Cup…,” Gill counters Manjrekar's claim about Kohli choosing to stick with 'easiest' format
item.description: India skipper Shubman Gill has hit back at Sanjay Manjrekar for claiming that Virat Kohli chose the ‘easiest’ format to play for the final phase of his international career by retiring from Tests and T20Is. Gill argued that ‘resilience, persistence and determination’ are needed to excel in ODIs. He also added that if the format was so easy, India would have lifted more World Cups since 2011. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “I think the atmosphere is amazing,” Shubman Gill dismisses reports of rift in India’s ODI dressing room
item.description: The three-match ODI series between India and New Zealand is all set to get underway on Sunday (January 11) in Vadodara. On the eve of the first ODI, India skipper Shubman Gill addressed a press conference, where he reflected on what it was like to have veteran campaigners such as Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma still doing their thing in the XI. Kohli and Rohit will be back in action during the New Zealand ODIs. Both of them looked in fine touch in recent series against Australia and South Africa.

item.title: WATCH: Yuvraj Singh mentors another Indian cricketer, spotted working with Sanju Samson ahead of T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: A viral nets video has put India wicketkeeper-batter Sanju Samson on the spotlight ahead of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, slated to be held in India and Sri Lanka from February 7 to March 8.
